input: s is an ASCII lowercase string, possibly empty, and target is a nonempty ASCII lowercase string. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt.
return: Maximum number of disjoint copies of target constructible by rearranging and consuming characters from s.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Histogram counts are at most string lengths, within 2^32-1; integer floor quotients are exact at these bounds. Nonempty target guarantees at least one limiting character and prevents division by zero. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(len(s)+len(target)+26) time and O(26) auxiliary space, including both complete histograms. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.

helpers.name: letterCounts
helpers.contract: Returns a fresh ASCII lowercase histogram with 26 integer entries.
helpers.cost: O(L+26) time/O(26) space per call; reused definition from 1160 is fully charged. Its complete definition is 216 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines count toward total source bytes.
